source_review.notes: Checked the original Karp-Rabin and Carter-Wegman publication records and DOIs, the official MIT Press record for CLRS fourth edition, and Cambridge University Press DOI records for Motwani-Raghavan and Gusfield. Durable mathematical and algorithmic claims are attributed within their stated models.

evidence: Checked sequence slices, polynomial orientation, outgoing coefficient, residues, candidate and verification costs, field notation, and balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The chapter consistently uses half-open windows and the leftmost coefficient b^(m-1).

evidence: Recomputed H(314)=11, the 231-to-314 rolling update, the 000/101 forced collision, exercise residues modulo 13, the single-pair collision bound, and its one-million-comparison union bound.

Exhaustively checked 15,810 nonempty binary pattern/text cases through pattern length 5 and text length 7 against a naive oracle while comparing every rolling residue with fresh polynomial evaluation.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All exhaustive outputs and rolling-state checks agreed; the deliberate collision was rejected by exact verification.

evidence: Re-derived the rolling equation by removing the b^(m-1) term, shifting the remaining polynomial, and inserting the incoming coefficient.
Re-derived exactness from deterministic fingerprint preservation plus full candidate equality.
Re-derived the random-base bound from the degree bound on a nonzero difference polynomial over a finite field and the multi-comparison bound by the union bound.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The exceptional zero-polynomial case caused by encoding congruence modulo q is explicit.

evidence: Checked m=1, m=n, m>n, overlaps, no matches, all matches, zero-valued symbols, negative intermediates, forced collisions, duplicate patterns, same-hash buckets, and chunk-spanning windows.
Checked public fixed parameters, adaptive collision search, seed exposure, correlated double hashes, overflow, ambiguous encodings, output floods, restart state, and destructive deduplication.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Empty-pattern behavior is deliberately an external API policy and rejected by the executable example.

evidence: Checked that the logical window and stored fingerprint remain aligned before every shift, pattern and window parameters remain identical, earlier shifts are classified exactly, and reports require full equality.
Exhaustive execution asserted rolling-state equality with fresh recomputation at every legal window.
invariant_checking.notes: Streaming state requirements preserve both the hash and exact-verification evidence across chunks.

evidence: Reviewed the filter-then-verify exactness theorem in both completeness and soundness directions.
Reviewed the rolling-update theorem coefficient by coefficient.
Reviewed the root-count collision lemma under prime modulus, nonzero difference polynomial, sampled base set, fixed-input, and adversary assumptions.
proof_review.notes: Collision probability governs candidate work only in the exact implementation; worst-case O(nm) verification remains explicit.

evidence: Audited uses of theorem, lemma, proof, exact, deterministic, probabilistic, expected, worst case, Monte Carlo, universal, and cryptographic.
Separated field-theoretic proof obligations from implementation observations and threat-model judgments.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No empirical collision rate is presented as proof of a family bound or adversarial guarantee.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet exited zero with the exact expected matches, candidate counts, and forced-collision rejection on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
An independent exhaustive oracle checked 15,810 finite binary cases and every rolling residue.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The observed runs establish behavior only for the recorded environment and finite tested domain.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed representation, polynomial orientation, rolling derivation, filter-then-verify exactness, deterministic cost, finite-field probability, random-parameter assumptions, streaming, multi-pattern buckets, and evidence boundaries. Scope leaves ordered full-text indexes to ALGE-055.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed integer overflow and remainder semantics, seed generation and scope, adaptive inputs, correlated hashes, canonical encoding, chunk boundaries, recovery state, bucket collision handling, output pressure, parameter rotation, authentication boundaries, and destructive-action safeguards.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives the mechanism and its exact and probabilistic contracts, includes ten distinct arithmetic, proof, collision, adversarial, streaming, multi-pattern, and production examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, cryptographic, security, performance, storage-system, or operational review is claimed. Results remain conditional on the stated sequence representation, arithmetic, hash-family, randomness, threat, streaming, and resource assumptions.
